scope: Standalone synthetic-data human review worksheet, not a product screen or model qualification

coldRead.method: Independent stateless completion given the complete HTML without session context
coldRead.understood: Read eight synthetic dialogues, enter three judgments, download JSON and return it
findingsDisposition: Reviewer identity is intentionally not collected for this single-user worksheet. Multiple reviewers must submit separately with attribution in the accompanying message.
The source corpus path is recorded; the originating conversation has the existing answers. The answer key is deliberately not distributed to the reviewer.
The exact privacy boundary is being elicited, not prescribed by model-authored examples. Uncertainty is collected explicitly.
Human feedback remains pending adjudication. This worksheet does not authorize release or amend existing criteria.

limitations: Only Chromium was exercised; other browsers were not tested.
Print media content was checked; a PDF file was not generated.
No model inference or production integration was exercised.
